時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 8 years apart, Tawan starts a security company, is hired as a bodyguard by Ayla, a famous singer facing stalker and enemy threats. As they reconnect, childhood feelings rekindle, and Ayla, with friends’ help, tries to win Tawan’s heart. Family opposition challenges their love. Can they overcome obstacles and reunite?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真的劇作家智恩以為中大獎而出國旅遊，回來卻發現自父母留下的美麗大屋「Full House」被賣掉，為了把房子要回來，在種種陰差陽錯下與新房東--頂級明星英宰協議結婚並共同生活的愛情故事。
事業不順的模特兒葉山南，婚禮當日又被未婚夫逃婚並騙光積蓄，不得不與未婚夫原室友，失意的年輕鋼琴家瀨名秀俊同住。瀨名提議把這當作「神賜予的悠長假期」鼓勵了因失婚而沮喪的南。
時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？

時隔八年後重逢, Tawan創辦了一家保安公司, 並被著名歌手Ayla聘為保鑣。兩人重逢後,童年的情愫再次浮現。Ayla在朋友的幫助下努力贏得Tawan的心。然而家庭衝突卻阻礙了他們的愛情。他們能否克服重重障礙, 再次走在一起？
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 8 years apart, Tawan starts a security company, is hired as a bodyguard by Ayla, a famous singer facing stalker and enemy threats. As they reconnect, childhood feelings rekindle, and Ayla, with friends’ help, tries to win Tawan’s heart. Family opposition challenges their love. Can they overcome obstacles and reunite?

丁雲齊破了周裘海的巽風甕，帶著孫三玄離開，三玄把龍骨交給了雲齊。被駱九天攔截的雲齊把龍骨交給無雙暫時保管。駱雲松帶手下包圍周裘海的太乙錢莊，想要找到雲齊。三玄讓雲齊繼任崑崙天官，但雲齊曾立誓不入五門。
駱九天提出與無雙成親，周裘海以丁雲齊下了聘禮為由拒絕，駱九天拔槍搶走了龍骨。駱雲松將無雙當作誘餌誘捕丁雲齊，丁雲齊冒險救出無雙，二人經地道逃脫。無雙認為師父已經將自己許配給了丁雲齊，丁雲齊卻一口否認。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！
未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
小祭提議嘗試雙人組合，休伊於是辦一場「憑感覺雙人配對大賽」，讓大家向心儀的對象推薦自己。甜音與希娜組隊，小祭與阿烏魯被喵姆拉走，剩下的檸檬與米露琪都表示自己一個更樂得輕鬆。

epg.programme_title_en: Amazing Animals - New Records of Animals #8 [Can/Man]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！
種植是一門學問，每個品種都有牠的特性，種植前務必做足功課。這集「大世界 小知識」發問四道有關萬壽菊的問題，各位小朋友又認識幾多？有小朋友稱在學校見到萬壽菊，認為牠和教師有關，故選定花語是「善良的教育」，但答案似乎有異。澆水是種植時的重要一環，為萬壽菊澆水前，應做甚麼檢查？而花盆盆底需要有排水孔、加上膠袋或擺放一些樹枝？打理萬壽菊雖不困難，但記得每兩至三星期要施肥，為植物提供充足養分。
大野的足球隊練習途中小休，正當他們準備吃飯糰，便吸引了餓肚子的小杉到場要飯。比賽在即，足球隊又剛好缺人，小杉便在健太等人邀請下，成為足球隊的外援球員。小杉憑著肥大的身形，擔任很稱職的守門員。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
從古到今，科學於我們的生活中無處不在。古人打仗時候使用的投石車，就是利用了槓桿原理，發射器和基座接觸的地方就是支點，而在發射器一端施加向下的壓力後，支點一邊往下，就會帶動支點另一邊向上用力，從而將放在發射板尾的石塊發射出去，這樣就能將石塊拋得又高又遠。古代亦有土人用吹矢作為武器，它又與甚麼原理有關呢？甚麼因素會影響矢的飛行距離？而木筏為甚麼能浮起？木筏又能夠承載多少重量？
巨人隊慘敗給暴龍隊，多啦A夢拿出「前路指示器」，讓大雄按指示走尋找解決方法。爸爸要去攀登尖岳，媽媽表示擔心並反對，多啦A夢拿出法寶「護身符」，見大家對功效存疑，便先以大雄作試驗。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

為甚麼天空中會有雲？只需要水和水壺作道具就可輕易解答。水受熱時會變成水蒸氣，繼而出白煙。雲的道理亦是一樣，當含有水蒸氣的熱空氣上升到一定位置時，會逐漸冷卻。冷卻的水蒸氣凝結成無數小水珠就會形成雲。而當遇到冷的環境，雲中的水滴就會變得越來越多。當雲裡面的小水珠太多，令雲越來越重，又或者熱空氣無法承托雲的時候，小水珠就會變成雨滴落下來。當雲受到風吹時，會不斷改變位置，那麼雲移動的方向與風向又有何關係？
大雄整天遲到，多啦A夢於是拿出「按鈕門」，讓大雄的房門可以直接連到課室。大雄和多啦A夢因為地租上升而被扣減零用錢，他們亂聊一通如何製造土地之際，多啦A夢忽然想到可以建造一個無人島。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
非傳統的體育運動都可歸類為新興運動，這次「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓帶來的「圓網球」就是其一。除了細述這項運動的規則，嘉賓亦引領Carmen姐姐與小朋友試玩。初步體驗後，參與眾人感覺如何？孩子們也好奇可在甚麼地方進行圓網球運動，公園草地和沙灘均是好場地。此外，由於所需的場地空間較少，小朋友在家中也可自行練習。
爺爺請小丸子吃蜜瓜雪葩，小丸子被雪葩的蜜瓜形外盒深深吸引，更把它當作收藏寶物的寶箱。可是，小丸子擁有的飾物都不過是玩具，更嫌棄雪葩外盒太孩子氣，於是請求爺爺幫忙找出得體的寶物與寶箱。

為甚麼天空中會有雲？只需要水和水壺作道具就可輕易解答。水受熱時會變成水蒸氣，繼而出白煙。雲的道理亦是一樣，當含有水蒸氣的熱空氣上升到一定位置時，會逐漸冷卻。冷卻的水蒸氣凝結成無數小水珠就會形成雲。而當遇到冷的環境，雲中的水滴就會變得越來越多。當雲裡面的小水珠太多，令雲越來越重，又或者熱空氣無法承托雲的時候，小水珠就會變成雨滴落下來。當雲受到風吹時，會不斷改變位置，那麼雲移動的方向與風向又有何關係？
大雄整天遲到，多啦A夢於是拿出「按鈕門」，讓大雄的房門可以直接連到課室。大雄和多啦A夢因為地租上升而被扣減零用錢，他們亂聊一通如何製造土地之際，多啦A夢忽然想到可以建造一個無人島。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
非傳統的體育運動都可歸類為新興運動，這次「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓帶來的「圓網球」就是其一。除了細述這項運動的規則，嘉賓亦引領Carmen姐姐與小朋友試玩。初步體驗後，參與眾人感覺如何？孩子們也好奇可在甚麼地方進行圓網球運動，公園草地和沙灘均是好場地。此外，由於所需的場地空間較少，小朋友在家中也可自行練習。

不少前來「My Little Show」的小朋友，都送上樂器演奏表演。文生爸爸展示有關瑞典樂器的相片，它貌似結他與提琴的混合體卻有大量按鍵，音色是怎樣的？這集有12歲的女表演者，帶來保養甚講究的單簧管。她憶述欣賞管弦樂團演出時，被獨奏的單簧管音韻吸引而決心學習，更提到單簧管的音調不高亦不低，類近人聲，吹起來似自己在唱歌般。表演者以單簧管獨奏樂曲選段，表演夠投入，又能否讓大家聽得陶醉？

飛機起飛、風帆車前行及風力發電機的推動等都是利用了空氣流動的原理。空氣流動具有甚麼特殊性質？只要在乒乓球上方吹氣，乒乓球即會彈起。這是因為當空氣流動得愈快，壓力就愈小，流動的空氣會產生吸力，令物體由壓力大的地方移去壓力小的地方。向著乒乓球吹氣時，乒乓球上方的空氣流動變快，乒乓球就被流動的空氣吸上來；而且愈用力吹氣，乒乓球就會被吸得愈高。運用這個原理，怎樣才能用吸管和水杯等簡單道具製成一個吸管噴壺？

飛機起飛、風帆車前行及風力發電機的推動等都是利用了空氣流動的原理。空氣流動具有甚麼特殊性質？只要在乒乓球上方吹氣，乒乓球即會彈起。這是因為當空氣流動得愈快，壓力就愈小，流動的空氣會產生吸力，令物體由壓力大的地方移去壓力小的地方。向著乒乓球吹氣時，乒乓球上方的空氣流動變快，乒乓球就被流動的空氣吸上來；而且愈用力吹氣，乒乓球就會被吸得愈高。運用這個原理，怎樣才能用吸管和水杯等簡單道具製成一個吸管噴壺？
多啦A夢收到期待已久的「自來水果汁轉換器」，大雄心生一計，成立水務署為大家拉果汁喉到家中。大雄希望手腳能自主活動，增加辦事效率，多啦A夢拿出「迷你腦袋」，為大雄的手腳賦予思考能力。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
不少前來「My Little Show」的小朋友，都送上樂器演奏表演。文生爸爸展示有關瑞典樂器的相片，它貌似結他與提琴的混合體卻有大量按鍵，音色是怎樣的？這集有12歲的女表演者，帶來保養甚講究的單簧管。她憶述欣賞管弦樂團演出時，被獨奏的單簧管音韻吸引而決心學習，更提到單簧管的音調不高亦不低，類近人聲，吹起來似自己在唱歌般。表演者以單簧管獨奏樂曲選段，表演夠投入，又能否讓大家聽得陶醉？

致力推廣新興運動的嘉賓再度亮相「Kids’ Notes」，繼圓網球後，他這次帶來另一款新玩意「躲避盤」。嘉賓提到躲避盤的玩法與閃避球相似，由十三人一隊互相對壘，當中更有淘汰與復活的規則，十分有趣。聽過講解，在場小朋友都躍躍欲試。嘉賓教導拋接技巧之餘，也讓部份小朋友和Carmen姐姐一同體驗躲避盤，大家一試隨即「上手」！

風是由高氣壓流向低氣壓而形成。夏天海洋氣壓比陸地高，風便經過海洋，帶著濕潤的空氣吹向陸地，帶來潮濕的天氣；到了冬天，海洋氣壓反過來比陸地低，風便經過陸地吹向海洋帶來乾燥的天氣，那就是每年必會遇到的季候風。那麼高、低氣壓到底是甚麼意思？而為甚麼高氣壓會代表天晴，低氣壓會代表陰天？我們又能否自製工具測量氣壓？颱風的形成亦與氣壓有關，但為甚麼颱風只會在温暖的海洋蘊釀，轉到陸地威力就會減弱？

正在睡覺的Nutty，被前來甜品城堡的四位小朋友喚醒。Nutty得悉蛋糕仙子趁他睡着時，竟把奇幻食材都吃掉，只好請求小朋友們幫手收集。首項任務是踏入果園摘食材，布甸隊男隊員寧棄眼前的一串提子，偏要挑戰較遠處兼較大粒的目標？另邊廂，啫喱隊女隊員匆匆摘下了西瓜，卻發覺西瓜不是採摘目標呢！接着是推地壺關卡，布甸隊兩兄弟輕鬆集得兩款奇幻食材，即使蛋糕仙子提出額外要求，他們都一一完成，食材數量更達四款之多！
小丸子在追逐蜻蜓的時候，碰巧去到一處從未去過的地方，並且看到一片宏偉的向日葵花田。在該處，小丸子遇到一個愁眉不展的姐姐。第二天，小丸子前往該處繪畫，碰巧那個姐姐也正在繪畫。之後，二人就開始了交流…

蠟燭由蠟質和燭芯組成，蠟質通常是石蠟，而燭芯就用比較優質的棉條製造。當蠟燭點著火時，蠟質受熱熔化成為液態蠟被燭芯吸收，透過「毛細作用」燭芯會將少量蠟質引上頂部，蠟質化成氣態蠟，在空氣之中燃燒就產生了燭光。哪些物質可以代替燭芯？我們能否利用類似性質的材料自製蠟燭？燃燒的蠟燭若用水杯蓋住，火焰就會熄滅。這是因為蠟燭處於密閉容器內，氧氣不足時，火焰就會熄滅。有甚麼方法可以用水杯罩住蠟燭，而火又不會熄滅？

正在睡覺的Nutty，被前來甜品城堡的四位小朋友喚醒。Nutty得悉蛋糕仙子趁他睡着時，竟把奇幻食材都吃掉，只好請求小朋友們幫手收集。首項任務是踏入果園摘食材，布甸隊男隊員寧棄眼前的一串提子，偏要挑戰較遠處兼較大粒的目標？另邊廂，啫喱隊女隊員匆匆摘下了西瓜，卻發覺西瓜不是採摘目標呢！接着是推地壺關卡，布甸隊兩兄弟輕鬆集得兩款奇幻食材，即使蛋糕仙子提出額外要求，他們都一一完成，食材數量更達四款之多！
小丸子在追逐蜻蜓的時候，碰巧去到一處從未去過的地方，並且看到一片宏偉的向日葵花田。在該處，小丸子遇到一個愁眉不展的姐姐。第二天，小丸子前往該處繪畫，碰巧那個姐姐也正在繪畫。之後，二人就開始了交流…

大雄打掃家裡門口，見到大人亂丟垃圾，好言相勸卻反被責罵，多啦A夢於是借他「可以教訓大人的臂章」。大雄晚歸被父母責罵，一氣之下離家出走，用竹蜻蜓飛到無人島，誰知一待下來便是十年。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

正在睡覺的Nutty，被前來甜品城堡的四位小朋友喚醒。Nutty得悉蛋糕仙子趁他睡着時，竟把奇幻食材都吃掉，只好請求小朋友們幫手收集。首項任務是踏入果園摘食材，布甸隊男隊員寧棄眼前的一串提子，偏要挑戰較遠處兼較大粒的目標？另邊廂，啫喱隊女隊員匆匆摘下了西瓜，卻發覺西瓜不是採摘目標呢！接着是推地壺關卡，布甸隊兩兄弟輕鬆集得兩款奇幻食材，即使蛋糕仙子提出額外要求，他們都一一完成，食材數量更達四款之多！
小丸子在追逐蜻蜓的時候，碰巧去到一處從未去過的地方，並且看到一片宏偉的向日葵花田。在該處，小丸子遇到一個愁眉不展的姐姐。第二天，小丸子前往該處繪畫，碰巧那個姐姐也正在繪畫。之後，二人就開始了交流…

今集起推出全新主題，並邀請香港兒童音樂劇團的導師介紹音樂劇知識。小朋友想成為音樂劇團員，必須通過身體律動、聲線和戲劇測試。音樂劇除了演技之外，唱歌和跳舞亦很重要。該團導師在「又唱又跳WE嘩鬼叫」環節中，特別挑選《小王子》音樂劇中的<看不見的圓舞曲>來示範唱歌及華爾茲舞步。另外，在「東張張西望望後台逐樣講」中，會講解化妝造型的重要性及作化妝示範。香港兒童音樂劇團的小演員還會演唱<看不見的圓舞曲>。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿烏魯不願參加雙人組合，小祭千方百計想令她回心轉意。阿烏魯以為眼鏡姐只是人工智能，卻發現對方有同理心，能體恤自己的感受。得知嘩查之間能產生共鳴，阿烏魯答應與小祭拍檔，期望化學反應。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩對父子同遊越南峴港，諾懿和長子黎峰睿先行探路，並接受熱身任務。諾懿給指令教峰峰做冰皮月餅，卻又忍不住爸爸天性連番出手……跟陳山聰、陳霆軒(Jaco)會合後，大隊坐船仔釣小蟹，還會玩默契二選一。考驗對兒子的了解度，爸爸們自信滿滿，但其中一題竟令山聰心碎！隱藏目標要讓兩小孩自發地牽手，爸爸忙着湊仔卻忘記要做任務。來到會安古城「猜猜畫畫」，單憑兒子的畫作找出三件手信，峰峰為整蠱爸爸，竟將圖畫抹去一半？
今集起推出全新主題，並邀請香港兒童音樂劇團的導師介紹音樂劇知識。小朋友想成為音樂劇團員，必須通過身體律動、聲線和戲劇測試。音樂劇除了演技之外，唱歌和跳舞亦很重要。該團導師在「又唱又跳WE嘩鬼叫」環節中，特別挑選《小王子》音樂劇中的<看不見的圓舞曲>來示範唱歌及華爾茲舞步。另外，在「東張張西望望後台逐樣講」中，會講解化妝造型的重要性及作化妝示範。香港兒童音樂劇團的小演員還會演唱<看不見的圓舞曲>。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿烏魯不願參加雙人組合，小祭千方百計想令她回心轉意。阿烏魯以為眼鏡姐只是人工智能，卻發現對方有同理心，能體恤自己的感受。得知嘩查之間能產生共鳴，阿烏魯答應與小祭拍檔，期望化學反應。

生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿烏魯不願參加雙人組合，小祭千方百計想令她回心轉意。阿烏魯以為眼鏡姐只是人工智能，卻發現對方有同理心，能體恤自己的感受。得知嘩查之間能產生共鳴，阿烏魯答應與小祭拍檔，期望化學反應。

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #8 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 何兆鴻與兒子「搏啜」何少弘接着要結識新朋友，他竟是諾懿長子黎峰睿，蒙在鼓裡的諾懿可感意外？兩位靚太吳若希與李潔瑩安坐監控室，兆鴻、諾懿則要幫助兒子衝破挑食難關。為讓丈夫顯露真面目，若希提議扮停機；爸爸們深入交談，對老婆可有不滿？同場加映兆鴻氹兒子午睡畫面，好溫馨。父子合作找尋遊戲卡任務未遇困難，要說服峰峰將特別卡送給搏啜，才是真正考驗！若希希望母子重聚時，搏啜會上前表愛意，兆鴻能否完成終極任務？

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Were meeting animals who like to live in ice and snow. Junior and his magic mask dive deep underwater for a game of hide and seek with a playful seal, the Ninja Gorilla shows us how to make a penguin from balloons, and theres a song about a clever little bluebird.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Were meeting animals who like to live in ice and snow. Junior and his magic mask dive deep underwater for a game of hide and seek with a playful seal, the Ninja Gorilla shows us how to make a penguin from balloons, and theres a song about a clever little bluebird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Todays show begins with a round of ZooMoos Animal All Stars quiz; and todays questions are all about acrobatic animals. Then, in Pop Fiction, the Ninja Gorilla uses his awesome balloon twisting skills to tell the story of How the Antelope got her Coat. The animals of Madagascar feature in Dance Fever -- And you can join in dancing with them! And we finish with Owl performing his own poem about the Platypus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: We leap into today’s show with a round of our Animal All Stars quiz game; where the questions are all about animals who are super jumpers. Then the Ninja Gorilla uses his amazing balloon twisting skills to tell the story of The Rabbit and the Tiger. In “Dance Fever”, we’re dancing like Australian animals, so there’ll be lots of hopping! Then we finish with Owl presenting some fascinating facts about the flying frog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Things are getting hot on ZooMoo today; starting with a game of Animal All Stars where the questions are all about animals who live in hot, sunny places. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horrors haunt each family from within, and nothing is really as it seems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偏遠的茶鄉小鎮,從城市來了一位美術老師郭雲天,他帶來全新的美術觀點,發現具繪畫天份的古阿明,美術成績超爛,卻比誰都愛畫畫的古阿明,終於碰到看得懂他的畫的老師了,老師說他畫得好,其他人卻不認同...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Aming Gu, a 4th grader at Suzen Elementary School in Mount Tea, loves drawing and painting but always gets grade either B or C in art class.  Though everybody laughs at his poor grade, he doesnt m...

epg.programme_title_tc: 超級無敵追女仔2之狗仔雄心[粵/普]

epg.programme_title_en: Hau Emperor Falls in Love, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛延壽借選秀女歛財，王昭君不肯行賄落選。君唱出怨憤，為漢王聽見，於是懲處壽。壽施計向匈奴王進言，匈奴王逼令漢王交出君，兵臨城下，君無奈出塞和番，並施美人計殺死壽。君自盡，屍首飄回故土，與漢王夢中惜別。
謝聖視影星嘉玲為理想對像，一日，貌似嘉玲的張慧玲到公司任職，聖大喜，卻不知慧是經理周仁達的情婦，展開追求，慧無奈道出真相。聖傷心之餘，對慧多番侮辱，慧激動下自殺，聖送慧入院搶救。後聖與慧和好結為夫婦。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 含淚的玫瑰
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃秋白尋愛人江子萍不果。五年前萍為妹子青的學業而婉拒白的愛意。白遇上青並驚悉萍已死，原來萍嫁與白的同學凌漢後，難產離世。白完成萍的遺願，並與青情愫互生，豈料漢向青表白。漢終知白的苦心，退出赴羅馬發展。

epg.programme_title_tc: 懷念謝賢: 九九九命案
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝小瓊險被後父謝裕姦污，更逼她嫁給范玉山。其後裕被殺，黃二姑的表現，令雷探長起疑，可是二姑離奇斃命。瓊約會凌雲，惹山妒忌，於是誣告雲與命案有關，幸被雷識破。瓊與雲訂婚當晚，山潛入謝家，用槍指嚇瓊與雲…
鏢師劉義與助手馮鐵牛從惡霸王五手上救了少女李燕玲，牛與玲後來結成夫婦。五心有不甘，牛與義先後遭伏殺，玲被五捉去，與兒子失散。牛子長大成了幪面俠劫富濟貧，常與五作對，一次救人行動中，他與玲終於母子重逢。

epg.programme_title_en: Couple and the Magic Lamp, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
鏢頭呂騰空受託護送錦盒給金鞭大俠韓遜，不料江湖盛傳空護送武林至寶，空與妻西門一娘遭各派截劫，幸終把錦盒送交遜。遜發現內藏兒子頭顱，與空夫婦惡鬥，娘喪命。後遜被殺，其女玉霞誤會空是兇手，將空之子麟毒打。
莊健華被發現死於海灘，其表弟丁子傑懷疑華妻何麗萍串謀駱大標謀財害命。其後傑發現標是真兇，建議萍報警，萍卻決定殺標報仇，惜失敗，幸傑及時相救。標綁架萍子明仔，要萍單獨帶錢給他，傑放心不下，悄悄跟蹤萍……
許君傑為報答丁家珠相助解困，答應她假扮其夫婿，來瞞騙她失散多年的父親丁晚成。可是珠、傑破綻百出，令珠表哥蘇士超起疑，並收買傭人彩姐監視，終揭穿傑之身分。超欲娶珠謀其家產，惜事敗，成遂讓珠、傑弄假成真。
程允中到徐守江家中工作時，以為應徵家庭教師的伍月華是江的千金。後華往中的電器店獲聘為售貨員，中因誤會其身分而對她管接管送。兩人經常出現徐家，惹來江夫婦誤會彼此出軌，幸華向二人及中解釋，中與華共墮愛河。

王爺調戲岑梅娘，鄒詩魂為梅解圍。後魂得知梅是其未婚妻，惜梅父嫌魂窮，逼魂退婚，魂暗中與梅商討私奔。王爺得悉將魂打至重傷，幸被王爺之妹相救。大婚日，梅行刺王爺事敗，幸魂出現重創王爺，王爺醒悟成全魂和梅。

epg.programme_title_tc: 如來神掌怒碎萬劍門(五)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鐵面修羅騙小龍女服下蜈蚣毒降，迫她偷取寶物以修練「天殘腳」。羅擄走龍劍飛之妻裘玉華，飛救人不果受重傷。小龍女不齒其師所為，暗中相救飛夫婦，而飛則助小龍女解毒。小龍女與飛裡應外合，並聯同四大派終擊敗羅。
花國偉不務正業，花天酒地。一日，偉偶遇謝玉霞，一見傾心，遂請求父親讓其打理酒家，欲親近霞，又資助霞母治病，終打動了霞。豈料偉婚後故態復萌，霞施計騙偉金錢以保花家業。偉一貧如洗，決發奮做人，終獲霞原諒。
（續上集）呂麟被鬼聖盛靈囚於鬼宮。呂騰空帶同點蒼派及峨嵋派掌門向六指先生興師問罪，時各派到來展開混戰。譚月華在鬼奴幫助下救出麟。群雄被六指琴魔之琴音操縱，互相殘殺。麟與華等人歃血為盟，誓滅六指琴魔。

epg.programme_title_en: Lover Ever in Her Dream, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吳成業從澳門來港尋親不果，餓倒在林潔貞家後門，幸得貞父女相救，並留業寄住，貞父林伯更請蘇德成替業找工作。貞與業互生情愫，珠胎暗結。其後業獲老闆千金金寶蓮賞識，業貪慕虛榮，漸疏遠貞。伯死後，貞懷胎出城找業，望能早日成婚，豈料業忘恩負義，更為與蓮訂婚，竟謀殺貞，幸成趕至救了貞，並將真相告知蓮。貞求蓮放過業和尋業的蹤跡，蓮終在探望工傷的工人中，重遇業，即通知貞；貞趕來相見並原諒業，業覺悟，與貞回鄉生活。
王爺調戲岑梅娘，鄒詩魂為梅解圍。後魂得知梅是其未婚妻，惜梅父嫌魂窮，逼魂退婚，魂暗中與梅商討私奔。王爺得悉將魂打至重傷，幸被王爺之妹相救。大婚日，梅行刺王爺事敗，幸魂出現重創王爺，王爺醒悟成全魂和梅。

齊宣王偶遇文武雙全的鍾無艷，王見色起心，封艷為后，艷謝恩時王睹芳容半邊醜，後悔莫及。王冷落艷，寵愛妃子夏迎春，時番王來犯，王請求艷應戰。艷大敗番王後，無意中令容貌變美，她請旨將春打入冷宮，王無奈答應。
何慧仙驚見伯父何書麟中刀身亡，報警求助。原來仙夫劉大偉與洪剛為奪麟的家財，殺害麟，嫁禍給李文中。中找仙幫忙，發現飛刀手趙標乃兇手。偉、剛見事情敗露，欲殺仙奪其遺產，幸警方趕至，迅速在24小時內破案。
陳德昌常因應酬冷落賢妻李氏，更納二姑娘為妾。二姑娘與廖畢誠有染，兩人使計令昌趕走李氏，又買兇殺其子小志，幸得老僕秋伯相救。多年後，昌得知二姑娘惡行，在誠與二姑娘挾帶私逃時報警將其拘捕，與志及李氏團聚。
元帝無道，欺壓百姓，陶安、陶國兄弟欲投靠朱元璋的義軍，卻遭奸人所害以致家破人亡。後來，安幾經辛苦終尋回妻子大娘與女兒小安，豈料欽差垂涎大娘的美色，他強搶大娘並把安拘捕，幸國帶人趕至，成功救出兄嫂。
胡劍勤與林安妮兩夫婦互換崗位，誰能應付自如可當一家之主。妮穿上迷你裙到鄰居張秋平工作的洋行上班；勤對家務一竅不通，平妻李美玉幫忙。鄭經理欲迷姦妮，平及時相救，勤、玉誤會二人有染。幸妮父施計終平息風波。

陳德昌常因應酬冷落賢妻李氏，更納二姑娘為妾。二姑娘與廖畢誠有染，兩人使計令昌趕走李氏，又買兇殺其子小志，幸得老僕秋伯相救。多年後，昌得知二姑娘惡行，在誠與二姑娘挾帶私逃時報警將其拘捕，與志及李氏團聚。
元帝無道，欺壓百姓，陶安、陶國兄弟欲投靠朱元璋的義軍，卻遭奸人所害以致家破人亡。後來，安幾經辛苦終尋回妻子大娘與女兒小安，豈料欽差垂涎大娘的美色，他強搶大娘並把安拘捕，幸國帶人趕至，成功救出兄嫂。
胡劍勤與林安妮兩夫婦互換崗位，誰能應付自如可當一家之主。妮穿上迷你裙到鄰居張秋平工作的洋行上班；勤對家務一竅不通，平妻李美玉幫忙。鄭經理欲迷姦妮，平及時相救，勤、玉誤會二人有染。幸妮父施計終平息風波。
陸青雲與戀人白秋兒連番遭奸人周沖加害，兒不幸被殺，雲逃離。實屬帝裔之後的兒，獲萬事聖母相救，並給予天書解困。兒跟從聖母指示化成生母的人頭，向皇帝告御狀。沖終被斬首，兒獲封公主，並與已成狀元的雲成眷屬。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 梁寬得知曾炳的小妾與吳大鵬合謀奪炳田產，寬決為炳出頭。鵬派人捉走炳子，要脅炳賤賣田地，寬與鵬展開惡鬥，卻不敵被擒，幸得鵬女營救。鵬命人放火燒曾宅，曾家等人與寬同告失蹤。時林世榮到來，與寬合力將鵬懲治。
劉志平與淑敏結婚多年仍未有子嗣，平母求孫心切為兒媳求子。司機阿福冒平之名結識了馮碧玉，害敏誤會平有外遇。平母以為玉懷下平的骨肉，欲平納玉為妾，敏憤而出走。福道出真相，時敏發現已有身孕，平母終得償所願。
徐子超目睹女友羅鳳玲墮樓身亡後，遇上劉福善，並得知羅伯豪當年強搶善妻及其孿生長女玲。玲受豪操縱販毒，直至重遇家人後欲擺脫豪，卻慘遭殺害，而與超相戀的是玲妹鳳珠。超得悉真相後，使計把豪誘到家中繩之以法。
明末亂世，華雲表得獨臂神尼相助，救回被金吊兒擄走的文鳳子，又知悉八八道士率領的十五門派與滿人勾結。表、鳳等在他們起事之日，將十五門派瓦解。時清兵入關，尼感凋零國事難挽，著表等暫隱居，靜待時機滅清復明。

錦毛鼠白玉堂不忿展昭被封為御貓，一時意氣盜取包公的御賜三寶。昭為取回三寶獨自赴約卻被困，幸終逃脫，昭妻不知情往營救亦中機關。堂的結義兄弟為免堂一錯再錯，與昭施計救出昭妻並取回三寶，堂認輸道歉獲昭原諒。
武志雄欲灌醉龍月桂成其好事，卻先醉倒，反而文卓輝與桂於酒後春風一度，惟桂以為失身於雄。輝、雄救駕有功，由於桂認定雄為夫，輝便成為御妹夫婿。後雄得知桂與輝之事憤而退婚，於是皇帝再配對，兩對佳偶終成眷屬。
佘仲全為捕蛇女周錦嫦所救，兩人甚為投契。全嫂花千嬌潑辣，常欺負全一家，讓全不滿。全與嫦欲共諧連理及開店，但屢遭嬌刁難，嫦不甘示弱，與嬌展開連場鬥法。嬌父窩娼聚賭、欺壓良民，被知縣拘捕，嬌亦得應有教訓。
黑風寨寨主金清欲將女兒許配予黃天霸，霸砌辭推搪，後來卻另娶張桂蘭。金家不忿，偷取王爺的玉印嫁禍於霸。霸查出一切並成功取回玉印，但他因私放清父女而遭王爺拘禁。蘭等人趕往救霸，並勸服清父女自首，平息風波。
死囚老董、鄧鵬、傻仔張、慢電、鐵拐李、大隻孫、歪咀鴻七人，與日軍翻譯刀疤李被帶到荒島收藏黃金。期間眾人將日軍殺死，私奪黃金，並躲在荒郊。眾人財迷心竅，互相想殺死對方獨佔巨財，但最終得不償失，性命不保。

蓮屏公主撞破西宮姦情遭滅口，屏逃出生天得張秋生收留，鄰居九叔作媒，撮合二人並誕下女兒阿玲。西宮表弟看中屏，以玲性命逼屏下嫁，屏救女心切將他殺死而被捕。生與屏潛逃，惜事敗同判死刑，九教玲入宮面聖救父母。
林凝碧遭軒轅楚逼婚，幸得淳于俊等人相助，楚遂與他們擇日再戰。俊與碧為對付楚而前往尋找神兵及靈藥，途中結識鍾素文與唐子羽。其後楚欲奪武林聖物天香荳蔻，俊等人與楚激戰，文為救俊而受重傷，俊誓奪荳蔻相救。
新任的遊樂場總經理阮秉南與歌女金露華互生好感，其未婚妻陳瑪莉因妒忌將華辭退。華後來收養了一棄嬰，卻被南的父母及莉誤會是南的骨肉，莉更因此與南解除婚約。最後棄嬰父親出現並取回嬰兒，南與華亦得以結成佳偶。

epg.programme_title_en: Tower of a Dozen Beauties, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李海燕與衛鼎儀相戀，卻被逼嫁富商賈彥齡，讓儀誤會她貪圖富貴。儀結識了賈季蘭，後驚悉燕竟是蘭之兄嫂，他與燕糾纏時，齡誤會二人有染，誤殺了燕。二十年後，齡出獄，儀亦從南洋回來，並向齡道出當年被誤會的真相。
連玉嬌與孟秀石有婚約，但她誤會石為採花賊留書出走。其實真正的採花賊為五大劍客的任雲天，嬌一直希望從五大劍客中選得夫婿，故不虞有詐，答允嫁天，幸石偕五大劍客的狄無涯趕至，揭穿天的真面目，嬌與石終成眷屬。

故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述于唐朝年間,沙陀國主有十三義子,皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英,因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間,最後更演變成兄弟相殘。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince,  a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威力無敵的兵器鴛鴦刀將要送給滿清的皇帝,卻不慎落入蕭中慧和袁冠南手裏。大內高手卓天雄於是出發追捕二人,誓要取回鴛鴦刀。大戰一觸即發,此刻鴛鴦刀的秘密也同被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the bat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害,雙腳更被凍至殘廢;長大後練就非凡武功,矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識,天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來,卻對她的遭遇非常同情,主動為她治好腳疾……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre yea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院,終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現,改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警,最終成功不讓房東出售家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, defle

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技,誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是,他潛入凌家作護衛,期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長,兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Cheng Ying’s father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling’s house where he meets his long-lost brother

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be app

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡,希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要,但卻碰上連串的奇遇,乾隆更被衙差關進牢獄,差點要被斬首…最後又有誰可拯救皇帝出困境?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fig

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King’s sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素,欲與其結合,央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親,撮合一段人鬼姻緣,馬素年青憨直,不願與鬼為伍,堅決拒絕,實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,決定伺機行動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

epg.programme_title_en: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘,為了朝夕幽會,竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外,乾隆神出鬼沒,嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義,更在賭坊大破賭局。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong’s caught in the Mong’s territory and as punish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲,幾近全軍覆沒,僅存兩名兒子生還。楊家五子遂逃入少林寺,向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」,後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」。最終,楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手,為楊家將報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang’s escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and tea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權,甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人,之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子,於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武當弟子傅玉書殺害掌門後,嫁禍掌門之私生子雲飛揚,並接任掌門及下令要追殺他。雲飛揚誓要為父報仇,於是苦練天蠶功要打敗傅玉書。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief’s illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father’s death and learns the invincible silkwo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,武義親王恃勢弄權,為奪紫光劍,不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧,並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡,借弔祭為名,實以武力奪劍。甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際,表親徐進到訪,聯手殺退惡奴,但大戰中,徐進、勝男等受傷,無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu’s son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong’s three daughters. Eventually, Gan’s daughters team up with their cousin Xu to aveng

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演,經典作《大軍閥》之延續,焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星,餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力,於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中,他們遇到了一名神秘俠客,三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪,竭力保護黃金不被劫走。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為九龍城寨被拆, 這部電影隨即被譽為不能重拍的經典。 江湖動作片中少有地拍出倫理片的感人兄弟情故事, 最後一場困獸式的死亡搏鬥, 以手提攝影機拍出瘋狂與悲涼, 被大特寫雜誌選為當年十大電影。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloons Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away fr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙春方曾於決鬥敗於龍帥之手下。七年後,龍帥為在賞燈大會上奪魁,往尋趙春方代為製造別緻燈籠。趙春方藉此暗中佈下復仇大計。龍帥之妻無固失蹤後,他驚聞有關人皮燈籠的傳說,並開始懷疑趙春方與失蹤事件有關......

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls’ high school, is stuck with a baby that isn’t his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽,各擅勝場,不同型格。電影風格奇特,一開始五毒門清理門戶,派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門,卻受師父追殺,有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运,張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇,沒有他慣常的大義浩然,卻有天地不容的毀滅性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Duke’s daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu m

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent’s consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she disc

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂決定隱瞞身份,進入華家作書僮,藉此接近秋香,並向她表明自己的身份和來意,可惜秋香並不相信。最後,唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下,終於抱得美人歸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo di

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung’s house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung’s mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat’s

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Director Christopher Nolan invites you into the world of The Odyssey, his mythic action epic of Homer’s saga, and the first film shot entirely with IMAX Film Cameras.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierce Brosnan stars in Dante’s Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德・范達美主演本片,由動作大師吳宇森執導,一場緊張刺激的生死追擊即將展開——他對抗一群以獵殺人類為娛樂的致命組織。聯合主演包括藍斯・亨里克森與威爾福・布利姆利。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this John Woo action thriller where a man battles a deadly group that hunts humans for sport. Also features Lance Henriksen and Wilford Brimley.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位充滿希望的洛杉磯女演員與一位失憶女子結為好友。當她們共同尋找她身份的過程中,現實與幻覺交織,這是一場如夢似幻,關於野心、身份與好萊塢黑暗面的驚悚之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在他的搭檔湯姆韋恩和家人被臭名昭彰且難以捉摸的刺客羅格(李連杰)殺害後,聯邦調查局特工約翰克勞佛(傑森斯坦森)開始沉迷於報復,因為他的世界陷入了內疚和背叛的漩渦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his partner Tom Wynne and family are killed by the infamous and elusive assassin Rogue (Jet Li), FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge as his world unravels into a vortex of guilt and betrayal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a fugitive couples glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure erupts into a maze of double-crosses, close escapes, false identities, and head-spinning romantic snafus, they come to realize that all they can count on is each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對從小失散的同卵雙胞胎——一位是居住在紐約的音樂家,另一位是生活在香港的技工——多年後因音樂家的演奏會行程來到香港,意外重逢,引發一連串錯綜有趣的事件。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Identical twins – a musician living in New York, and a mechanic living in Hong Kong – are separated in childhood but are unexpectedly reunited years later when the musician travels to Hong Kong for a concert.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1872年,一位英國發明家、一位中國小偷和一位法國藝術家出發,用80天完成環球航行。他們通過海陸空和滾軸溜冰,爭分奪秒回到起點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is 1872, and a British inventor, a Chinese thief and a French artist set off to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days. They travel by land, air, sea, and in-line skates in order to beat the clock and finish where they started.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1872年,一位英國發明家、一位中國小偷和一位法國藝術家出發,用80天完成環球航行。他們通過海陸空和滾軸溜冰,爭分奪秒回到起點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is 1872, and a British inventor, a Chinese thief and a French artist set off to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days. They travel by land, air, sea, and in-line skates in order to beat the clock and finish where they started.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧斯卡金像獎®提名者西爾維斯特史泰龍主演的這部動作驚悚片,將帶您體驗腎上腺素飆升的快感,直到最後一格震撼人心的畫面!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落。一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在充斥著貪腐、謀殺以及影星光環的繁華背後,三名警官誓死奮戰,只為揭開一起殘忍連環慘案背後的駭人真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅素克洛在雷德利史考特的史詩巨制《羅賓漢》中飾演羅賓漢——在這段傳奇中,他奮起對抗腐敗,點燃反叛之火,讓一位卑微的亡命之徒化身為永恆的自由象徵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Russell Crowe stars as Robin Hood in Ridley Scott’s epic reimagining—fighting corruption and sparking a rebellion that turns a humble outlaw into a timeless symbol of freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名在越戰中陣亡的士兵多年後被改造成半人半機的超級戰士。然而,當記憶逐漸甦醒,他們掙脫束縛,在昔日戰友之間展開了一場殘酷的對決。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two soldiers killed in Vietnam are revived years later as cyborg super-soldiers. But when memories return, they break free—setting up a brutal showdown between former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《邁阿密風雲》中,由傑米・福克斯與柯林・法洛飾演的臥底警探深入毒品世界,在危險、誘惑與犯罪中周旋。這部風格鮮明、緊張刺激的作品重新演繹經典影集,同時由鞏俐聯袂主演。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《反恐戰場》中,傑米福克斯率領一支菁英FBI小組前往沙烏地阿拉伯追捕一名恐怖分子——這是一場文化與正義的緊張交鋒。該片由彼得柏格執導,麥可曼監製。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Foxx leads an elite FBI team to hunt a terrorist in Saudi Arabia in The Kingdom—a tense clash of cultures and justice, directed by Peter Berg and produced by Michael Mann.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Combat has taken its toll on Rambo, but he’s finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When Rambo’s friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, Rambo declines but must reconsider when Trautman is

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Doomsday, a deadly virus resurfaces decades after quarantine. As chaos erupts, a team enters the walled-off zone to find a cure. Action-packed and gritty, its a battle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an effort to jumpstart his career after his superhero movie franchise dies, a psychotic actor writes, directs, and stars in a broadway play that becomes an unlikely hit after he tries to shoots himself in the head during the premiere.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: CIA探員Tara接受了一項祕密政府實驗,獲得以DNA轉換成任何人的能力,成為終極潛入者。然而,當父親遭到謀殺、線索竟指向她所屬的機構時,Tara被迫脫離組織、展開逃亡。如今,她必須阻止被竊的濃縮鈾引..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曾是東北街頭武霸的阿能為了出人頭地,洗心革面來到香港的九龍城寨從零開始打拼,不料卻捲入一場黑惡勢力間的陰謀和混戰。最終為保護被黑惡勢力追殺的好朋友,阿能重拾自我,挺身而出,與城寨居民一同對抗黑惡勢力,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們跟隨印尼名模 Patricia 和 Chika 探索這座城市的隱秘寶藏和知名地標,沉浸在強烈對比的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Indonesian famous models Patricia and Chika as they explore the citys hidden gems and vibrant scenes, immersing themselves in amazing contrasts and trendy vibes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Erin,一名飽受創傷與怒火困擾的女子,前往偏遠莊園探訪男友的家人,卻發現對方竟是操控血腥交易的邪教。當她被擄並成為獵物時,壓抑已久的怒火徹底爆發,反轉局勢,展開一場殘酷的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 驅魔龍族傳人馬小玲與身份成謎的冷酷偵探況天佑,因連環詭異案件在香港狹路相逢。一個是以斬妖除魔為己任的暴躁天師,一個是隱匿於現代都市,遊走在黑暗邊緣的不死嗜血異類。兩人從互相對立猜忌到結下宿命羈絆,決定..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling solves supernatural mysteries and battles evil spirits. During her investigations, she crosses paths with mysterious detective Fong, whose hidden past is tied to a dark destiny. Though distrustful at first, the two become allies and join forces to confront a terrifying evil threatening the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工阿文被安排潛伏於東南亞的軍火商旗下,尋找其手中的一批軍火炸藥並將其銷毀。當他終於找到該批軍火後,卻遭到不明匪徒襲擊。為防止災難發生,阿文決定與他的特工搭檔阿瓊合力奪回軍火。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.
