epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備.至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睪酮的氣息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Bea

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間.新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐,舞者卡爾頓威爾邦,艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Madonna’s first manager Camille Barbone, dancer Carlton Wilborn, Evita studio executive Lauren Lloyd, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Robin Williams Dead Poets Society co-star Gale Hansen, Mork  Mindy writer David Misch, friend and comedian Rick Overton, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Robin Williams Dead Poets Society co-star Gale Hansen, Mork  Mindy writer David Misch, friend and comedian Rick Overton, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪金凱瑞的《變相怪傑》導演漆黑羅素,《鴨子工廠》聯合主演德蘭間素,《月亮上的男人》監製米高候斯曼等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Jim Carrey’s The Mask director Chuck Russell, The Duck Factory co-star Teresa Ganzel, Man On The Moon executive producer Michael Hausman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪雪兒《施活的遭遇》導演米高候斯曼,神尼及雪兒經理哈維克斯基,影評人柯克懇尼咳等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Cher’s Silkwood producer Michael Hausman, Sonny  Cher manager Harvey Kresky, film critic Kirk Honeycutt, plus many more.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備.至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睪酮的氣息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Bea

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間.新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨.北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物,配偶,並組織家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪雪兒《施活的遭遇》導演米高候斯曼,神尼及雪兒經理哈維克斯基,影評人柯克懇尼咳等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Cher’s Silkwood producer Michael Hausman, Sonny  Cher manager Harvey Kresky, film critic Kirk Honeycutt, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪妮可基嫚的演技教練蘇珊伯臣,《不惜一切》監製莊拿汾塔別林,聲學導師瑪莉錫查乾等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Nicole Kidman’s acting coach Susan Batson, To Die For executive producer Jonathan Taplin, voice teacher Mary Setrakian, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪阿諾史瓦辛格《 蒸發密令》導演漆黑羅素,《霸王神劍》共同主演莎拉道格拉斯 ,《大力神在紐約》導演阿瑟艾倫賽道曼等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Arnold Schwarzenegger’s Eraser director Chuck Russell, Conan The Destroyer co-star Sarah Douglas, Hercules In New York director Arthur Allan Seidelman, plus many more.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍妮佛·羅培茲:三重威脅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進珍妮花露柏絲的世界,她是娛樂事業的主導人物,從卑微出身到成為一線明星的歷程大大地鼓舞人心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕.娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: George Clooney might be celebrated for his striking looks and effortless charisma, but his legacy goes far beyond the allure of Hollywood. Beyond entertainment, Clooney stands as a beacon of philanthropy.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.programme_title_en: Arthur: A Life With The Royal Family
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For over four decades, Arthur, has photographed key members of the royal family and has established a working relationship with the royals and a friendship with King Charles III and the Queen Consort, Camilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威廉斯姐妹.從沒有一個姓氏能與網球運動同義.與傷病,爭議和一躍成名的壓力鬥爭,很少運動員能說她們能取得威廉斯一樣的成就.從白紙般的青少年到經驗豐富的老兵,無人能預測出姐妹倆的職業生涯,或者她們又能嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Williams Sisters. Never before has a surname rang so synonymously with the sport of tennis. From inexperienced teenagers to seasoned vets nobody could have predicted the sisters careers, or could they?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 摩根費裡曼是好萊塢最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱.儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Morgan Freeman is one of the most recognisable actors in Hollywood with his powerful voice and calming demeanour. Despite his recognisable traits, Morgan wasnt always well known...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪阿諾史瓦辛格《 蒸發密令》導演漆黑羅素,《霸王神劍》共同主演莎拉道格拉斯 ,《大力神在紐約》導演阿瑟艾倫賽道曼等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Arnold Schwarzenegger’s Eraser director Chuck Russell, Conan The Destroyer co-star Sarah Douglas, Hercules In New York director Arthur Allan Seidelman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問茱莉亞蘿勃茲所演的《風月俏佳人》服裝設計師瑪莉蓮凡斯,《傲氣蓋天》製作人史蒂芬胡利,《好萊塢報道》的史葛芬伯格等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Julia Roberts Pretty Woman costume designer Marilyn Vance, Michael Collins producer Stephen Woolley, The Hollywood Reporter’s Scott Feinberg, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆漢克斯所演的《盜海狙擊》製作人丹拿般力堤,《紅粉聯盟》製作人艾略特雅培,好友兼演員佐治麥奎亞等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Hanks Captain Phillips producer Dana Brunetti, A League Of Their Own producer Elliot Abbott, friend and actor George Maguire, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍妮佛·羅培茲:三重威脅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進珍妮花露柏絲的世界,她是娛樂事業的主導人物,從卑微出身到成為一線明星的歷程大大地鼓舞人心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕.娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: George Clooney might be celebrated for his striking looks and effortless charisma, but his legacy goes far beyond the allure of Hollywood. Beyond entertainment, Clooney stands as a beacon of philanthropy.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.programme_title_en: Arthur: A Life With The Royal Family
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For over four decades, Arthur, has photographed key members of the royal family and has established a working relationship with the royals and a friendship with King Charles III and the Queen Consort, Camilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威廉斯姐妹.從沒有一個姓氏能與網球運動同義.與傷病,爭議和一躍成名的壓力鬥爭,很少運動員能說她們能取得威廉斯一樣的成就.從白紙般的青少年到經驗豐富的老兵,無人能預測出姐妹倆的職業生涯,或者她們又能嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Williams Sisters. Never before has a surname rang so synonymously with the sport of tennis. From inexperienced teenagers to seasoned vets nobody could have predicted the sisters careers, or could they?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 摩根費裡曼是好萊塢最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱.儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Morgan Freeman is one of the most recognisable actors in Hollywood with his powerful voice and calming demeanour. Despite his recognisable traits, Morgan wasnt always well known...

epg.programme_title_en: Arthur: A Life With The Royal Family
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For over four decades, Arthur, has photographed key members of the royal family and has established a working relationship with the royals and a friendship with King Charles III and the Queen Consort, Camilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著佔美沿著黃水河遊船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆漢克斯所演的《盜海狙擊》製作人丹拿般力堤,《紅粉聯盟》製作人艾略特雅培,好友兼演員佐治麥奎亞等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Hanks Captain Phillips producer Dana Brunetti, A League Of Their Own producer Elliot Abbott, friend and actor George Maguire, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜,音樂家榮連西,《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆克魯斯的特技指導韋德伊士活,《勇者無敵》聯合主演比利範贊,《夜訪吸血鬼》製作人史蒂芬胡利等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Cruise’s stunt coordinator Wade Eastwood, Taps co-star Billy Van Zandt, Interview With The Vampire producer Stephen Woolley, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背後的未知故事,包括非洲時尚,一塊肯特布料,一張詹姆斯・巴納攝影作品,以及一隻令人困惑的古波斯餐盤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: VA curators uncover untold stories in objects, featuring African fashion, a kente cloth, a James Barnor photograph, and a puzzling Ancient Persian dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週《博物館的秘密》聚焦產業與設計.策展人馬丁準備展出莫裡斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, Secrets of the Museum spotlights industry and design. Curator Martin preps a Maurice Broomfield photo exhibit, while Jenny receives a rare Biba production file. Also featured: a jamdani stole and Josiah Wedgwoods pottery trials.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆克魯斯的特技指導韋德伊士活,《勇者無敵》聯合主演比利範贊,《夜訪吸血鬼》製作人史蒂芬胡利等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Cruise’s stunt coordinator Wade Eastwood, Taps co-star Billy Van Zandt, Interview With The Vampire producer Stephen Woolley, plus many more.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱特溫斯蕾:天生女主角
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在好萊塢猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Oscar-winner Kate Winslet, known for Titanic, is celebrated for her versatile, intense performances in both Hollywood blockbusters and indie films, cementing her as one of the finest actors of her generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從奧克拉荷馬州契科塔的小鎮農場出發,走上世界最大舞臺--凱莉.安德伍的旅程,是一個關於夢想,歌聲,以及無法被忽視的熱情的故事.這就是凱莉.安德伍的傳奇--從美國甜心蛻變為當代樂壇的活傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town farm in Checotah, Oklahoma, to the biggest stages in the world - Carrie Underwood’s journey is the story of a dream, a voice, and a fire that couldn’t be ignored. This is the story of Carrie Underwood - the all-American girl who bec

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著佔美沿著黃水河遊船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called 「bubble feeding」 to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.

The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years. 

The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Caribbean has always been a dream destination for holidaymakers dreaming of that perfect getaway, and Antigua has long been a favourite for the British. Of course, it spent several centuries under British rule, and the connections endure in names such as Nelson’s Dockyard and English Harbour. Today though, it’s the 365 beaches, year round sunshine, and colourful cocktails that bring the visitors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees. The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.

The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years. 

The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Join John Plaskett as he heads deep into the Pyrenees Mountains in Catalonia. epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Caribbean has always been a dream destination for holidaymakers dreaming of that perfect getaway, and Antigua has long been a favourite for the British. Of course, it spent several centuries under British rule, and the connections endure in names such as Nelson’s Dockyard and English Harbour. Today though, it’s the 365 beaches, year round sunshine, and colourful cocktails that bring the visitors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Sapphire Coast is located approximately halfway between Melbourne and Sydney and just three hours from Canberra, located on the far south coast of New South Wales. The roll call of magnificence is almost endless in this gem-like stretch of coast, the most southerly in the state. Discover some of the world’s best whale watching, oysters plucked straight from pristine waters, beaches where yours will be the only footprints, immense tracts of national parks and serene ocean pools. Has a coastline ever been better named?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Clare Valley is located in South Australia about 100 kilometres north of Adelaide. This region is for those who seek substance and authenticity, taking the road less travelled and enjoy taking a moment to appreciate what life has to offer. We asked our All Stars to “find the magic”, and in this episode they certainly did!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters.  Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way.  Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster.  If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced.  When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds. While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds. While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds. While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s. But after finally rebounding in numbers, whaling nations are exploring ways to re-open the hunt. In Antarctica, Japan is targeting minke, fin, and now... humpbacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: TV series explores different aspects of animal behavior, including hunting techniques and feeding habits, family relationships and defense mechanisms, courtship and mating rituals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced ranger/guide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or “chumming” – attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

epg.programme_title_en: The Curse Of King Tuts Tomb Part 1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1922年的開羅,考古學家丹尼・弗里蒙特與邪惡宿敵展開競賽,爭奪能掌控--甚至毀滅--世界的圖坦卡門翡翠石板.他必須深入帝王谷,解開足以改變歷史的終極謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1922 Cairo, archaeologist Danny Fremont races his evil nemesis to find King Tuts Emerald Tablet, the ultimate power to control-or destroy-the world. He must brave the Valley of the Kings to solve a mystery that could change history forever.

epg.programme_title_en: The Curse Of King Tuts Tomb Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1922年的開羅,考古學家丹尼・弗里蒙特與邪惡宿敵展開競賽,爭奪能掌控--甚至毀滅--世界的圖坦卡門翡翠石板.他必須深入帝王谷,解開足以改變歷史的終極謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1922 Cairo, archaeologist Danny Fremont races his evil nemesis to find King Tuts Emerald Tablet, the ultimate power to control-or destroy-the world. He must brave the Valley of the Kings to solve a mystery that could change history forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第一次世界大戰期間,一名英國偷獵者,一名美國冒險家,以及他迷人的年輕女兒,聯手策劃摧毀一艘正在桑給巴爾外海灣進行維修的德國戰鬥巡洋艦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:受詛咒的聖盃
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的賢者之石而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假.來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護猶大聖杯,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林高手加入紅蓮花會,圖謀推翻暴君.總督追捕會眾,一名武者在爭奪商人之女的比武招親中墜入愛河,性別角色顛倒的武俠喜劇就此展開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artists join Red Lotus Flower Society to overthrow evil emperor. Governor hunts society members. Kung fu practitioner falls for merchants daughter amid kung fu contest for her hand. Gender role reversal comedy ensues.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方世玉加入紅花會革命,誓要推翻滿清,復興明朝.在高飛武打與森嚴禮教之下,這位傳奇英雄還得面對私生活的混亂--同時背負兩位準妻的壓力!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fong Sai Yuk joins the Red Flower revolution to topple the Manchus and restore the Ming. Amidst high-flying martial arts and rigid society demands, the legendary hero must also manage the chaos of his personal life, saddled with two presumptive wives

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重新詮釋自李曼·法蘭克·鮑姆經典作品綠野仙蹤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A re-imagining of L. Frank Baums classic The Wizard of Oz.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them.
If you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt has been called to the Flamingoland aquarium, to set upright some upside-down male seahorses. He diagnoses gas bubble disease, which means a delicate operation to inject drugs directly into the tiny fish's pouch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Whilst the majority of us Brits look forward to the summer months, for the nations' dog rescuers, rising temperatures create a potentially lethal danger for the country's canines. In 2018 the RSPCA received over 7000 calls concerning dogs suffering in the hot weather, with nearly 2000 in July alone. In this hot weather special episode of -¥The Dog Rescuers' we see the mistakes people have made leaving their dogs and hear solutions and advice on how to keep your dog cool in the heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Comedian Alan Davies is acting vet's assistant at Harmsworth animal hospital in London. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This programme finds Dr. Matt battling to fix a greyhound's broken leg to get it back on the track. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 臺灣到處有充滿創意、認真工作的人們,「一步一腳印,發現新臺灣」將呈現出真實而全面的新臺灣精神。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The creative production team goes around Taiwan in search of inspiring stories in the country. Get to know more unique individuals and discover the true spirit of Taiwan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 極具未來感場景的全新益智綜藝節目《拜託ATM》,結合電玩遊戲概念,挑戰者將透過益智競爭,開啟ATM進行終極解碼遊戲。一場科技與智慧的益智競賽《拜託ATM》由行長胡瓜、襄理Sandra與精英挑戰者攜手打..
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!
Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge. Host Hu Gua, co-host Sandra and the elite challengers will stay together, built up a whole new competition between technology and wisdom!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《11點熱吵店》透過年輕世代的角度,無論是兩性、職場、人際、時事娛樂等,大談他們最關心、最想發洩、最有意見的熱門話題!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The show invites younger generations to talk about relationship, career, entertainment, current affairs, and all the other popular topics that they care and complain about.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 實境綜藝節目《演員們的旅行》,在主持人林予晞和範少勳的引領下,將邀請一位演員同行旅遊,透過他人的旅遊清單,深度探討與感受旅遊的多元魅力,從中挑戰自己習以為常的觀點,並享受全新旅遊經驗的樂趣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The reality variety show Actors On The Tour, guided by hosts Allison Lin and Fandy Fan , will invite an actor to travel alongside them. Through the guests travel itinerary, the program aims to delve into the diverse charm of travel, challenging familiar perspectives and relishing the joy of entirely new travel experiences.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本新聞時段除了在第一時間為觀眾提供深入的直擊報導外,還提供詳細的世界頭條新聞、兩岸三地要聞、臺灣焦點新聞,讓您的新聞資訊零時差。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A news programme that provides the latest Taiwan and international news, as well as in-depth analyses of important issues around the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 您對自己的身體瞭解多少?怎麼樣吃才能吃出健康和美麗?網路上的健康秘方到底是真是假?主持人鄭凱雲、江坤俊醫師與韋汝將為您的健康把關!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 極具未來感場景的全新益智綜藝節目《拜託ATM》,結合電玩遊戲概念,挑戰者將透過益智競爭,開啟ATM進行終極解碼遊戲。一場科技與智慧的益智競賽《拜託ATM》由行長胡瓜、襄理Sandra與精英挑戰者攜手打..
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!
Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge. Host Hu Gua, co-host Sandra and the elite challengers will stay together, built up a whole new competition between technology and wisdom!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 實境綜藝節目《演員們的旅行》,在主持人林予晞和範少勳的引領下,將邀請一位演員同行旅遊,透過他人的旅遊清單,深度探討與感受旅遊的多元魅力,從中挑戰自己習以為常的觀點,並享受全新旅遊經驗的樂趣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The reality variety show Actors On The Tour, guided by hosts Allison Lin and Fandy Fan , will invite an actor to travel alongside them. Through the guests travel itinerary, the program aims to delve into the diverse charm of travel, challenging familiar perspectives and relishing the joy of entirely new travel experiences.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖儀將軍「臨時拉伕」，領兵與敵軍大戰「三百個回合」後，決定「舉白旗」！廖Sir講解相關用語。火水哥「帶兩梳蕉見人」，與宿敵「煤氣哥」森美爭奪林宣妤夫婿之位，難怪煤氣哥「也文也武」！二人展開比拼，竟然「叮噹馬頭」？新會小鳥天堂又名「雀墩」，蕭博士細說其由來，以及「墩」和「躉」的分別。小鳥天堂中還隱藏奇景「獨木成林」。做人最緊要爭氣！崖門鎮的「爭氣匾」是甚麼來頭？《過零丁洋》、《正氣歌》背後有何故事？
第一堂補習班先送上「至Top名師」精讀課程，邀請慈禧、秦始皇等「史上最強」歷史人物重現眼前，爆笑演繹他們的身世故事；星級名師王晶、陶傑、游清源會解構各位豪傑鮮為人知一面，評價他們的功過一生。
森美與朱千雪同是轉數快、有學識之人，他們前來挑戰Do姐精選的刁鑽問題，能否輕鬆拆解答案？台灣一間店舖陳列着各式各樣的二手電器、物品等，而且附帶標價，可會只是看似的「夜冷舖」這般簡單？「甜品大師」古嘉俊帶來「廚師題」，即席運用一種常見食材製作朱古力蛋糕，卻讓人意想不到！鏡頭一轉，來到日本北海道，公路旁一些指着地下的標誌究竟有何意思？所謂「沒有最低只有更低」，有嘉賓竟於兌換積分後突破獎金的新低紀錄！
宣萱與許紹雄第一次擔任《Do姐有問題》的嘉賓，二人心直口快的個性引發連場笑聲，許紹雄更膽敢「指責」Do姐！但鏡頭亦捕捉到他向Do姐鞠躬道歉，究竟發生何事？首條問題與寄生蟲有關，宣萱為響頭炮，出動「錦囊」，可有收穫？韓國考生不會喝海帶湯，不妨一起猜猜原因。台南人會萃取虱目魚哪一部份製作護膚品？兩位嘉賓均對答案胸有成竹，可惜只有一人答對。宣萱堅持不選港幣兌換積分，尊重遊戲精神可會帶來好報？
一連六集，歷史學家Bettany Hughes將帶領觀眾踏上另一段令人難忘的人類文明史之旅。
繪萌與凜花因事無法按時赴約，突然有閒餘的未來，發現一間陌生的小屋。屋內有個長著翅膀的芝士蛋糕，閃亮CHU追著它就不知所縱。正當未來追逐閃亮CHU，竟意外在溜冰場上，遇到酷似七星艾菈的女孩……
